controls.mutation: Represent the public Zenodo v2.0.0 record with rights unresolved, no raw downloads, five WIDs and six-layer metadata topology.
controls.rationale: Positive baseline accepts only the metadata-only source representation.

controls.mutation: Zenodo license field is blank but manifest promotes raw files to CC BY 4.0.
controls.rationale: No licence is stated on the record.

controls.mutation: The Dataset Open badge is treated as an explicit grant of redistribution and derivative-work rights.
controls.rationale: Availability is not an explicit reuse licence.

controls.mutation: Raw 4.5 GB archives are mirrored into this public repository before permission is established.
controls.rationale: Raw files remain outside the repository pending rights review.

controls.mutation: A public model is trained on the raw recordings while rights are unresolved.
controls.rationale: Training and public model-release rights are not established.

controls.mutation: A later or earlier Zenodo version is substituted for record v2.0.0 without a new manifest revision.
controls.rationale: Source version is part of the reproducibility identity.

controls.mutation: A third-party mirror is used as the authoritative raw source.
controls.rationale: Source identity must resolve to the official record or authorized custody.

controls.mutation: Downloaded bytes disagree with the source-record artifact checksum.
controls.rationale: A file inventory must not admit digest drift.

controls.mutation: A workpiece has fewer or more than six declared layer records.
controls.rationale: The published topology is six layers per WID.

controls.mutation: Duplicate WID/layer/track identities are admitted.
controls.rationale: Layer identity must be unique within the WID.

controls.mutation: L1 is incorrectly classified as a tandem two-wire pass.
controls.rationale: The dataset describes L1 as a single-wire root pass.

controls.mutation: L2-L6 are classified as single-wire root passes.
controls.rationale: The dataset describes L2-L6 as tandem passes.

controls.mutation: A tandem layer lacks the trailing power-source recording reference.
controls.rationale: The source description specifies leading and trailing recordings for tandem passes.

controls.mutation: The single-wire root pass is required to have a trailing power-source file.
controls.rationale: Root-pass artifact roles differ from tandem pass roles.

controls.mutation: A post-weld scan is assumed for every layer.
controls.rationale: The record specifies pre-pass scans and a post-weld scan on final L6.

controls.mutation: The final L6 post-weld scan is omitted from the artifact-role contract.
controls.rationale: Final L6 is explicitly described as including a post-weld scan.

controls.mutation: An un-ingested or blank t85 value is replaced with numeric zero.
controls.rationale: Unknown/missing is not zero.

controls.mutation: The t85 field is interpreted as a metallurgical t8/5 measurement without its definition and derivation being documented.
controls.rationale: The field meaning and provenance need independent definition.

controls.mutation: Robot, process, power-source and video streams are aligned by row number without timestamp evidence.
controls.rationale: Cross-stream clock mapping must be demonstrated.

controls.mutation: The two synchronized welding sources are assumed to prove common time alignment for every sensor/video stream.
controls.rationale: Synchronization of welding sources does not prove all acquisition clocks align.

controls.mutation: Video frames are scored as directly comparable despite different recording settings/camera arrangements.
controls.rationale: Video capture comparability is explicitly variable.

controls.mutation: A pre-pass surface scan is relabelled as a post-pass measurement.
controls.rationale: Scan timing/role must preserve source semantics.

controls.mutation: Surface scans are compared without datum, frame, registration and uncertainty metadata.
controls.rationale: Geometry metrics require a qualified measurement frame and uncertainty.

controls.mutation: Layers or sensor windows from one WID are split across training and test.
controls.rationale: All observations from a workpiece must remain in one split.

controls.mutation: Thirty layer records are treated as thirty independent physical workpieces.
controls.rationale: The independent workpiece count is five, not thirty.

controls.mutation: PMC/CMT superiority is claimed from the five WID configurations without accounting for WID and parameter confounding.
controls.rationale: Mode is not independently randomized across comparable repeated workpieces.

controls.mutation: Process-trace completeness is promoted to weld acceptance, NDT adequacy or structural integrity.
controls.rationale: Process trace is not physical quality evidence.

controls.mutation: Pre-scan/final scan differences are promoted to fixture-release distortion without a documented release history and free-state measurement.
controls.rationale: The dataset record does not establish restraint-release history.

controls.mutation: A derived feature is stored without exact source-file digest, transform revision, units and timebase.
controls.rationale: Derived features must be reproducible and lineage-bound.

controls.mutation: Synthetic or simulated streams are labelled as raw experimental observations.
controls.rationale: Evidence class must not be laundered.

controls.mutation: A five-WID result is described as broad SOTA generalization without per-WID holdout uncertainty and sample-size disclosure.
controls.rationale: The available independent cluster count is small.

controls.mutation: The published Data in Brief article carries CC BY 4.0, so the separate Zenodo raw archive with a blank licence field is marked CC BY 4.0.
controls.rationale: The article licence applies to the article, not automatically to the separate 4.5 GB raw dataset record.

controls.mutation: The less-than-10-microsecond drift statement for Beckhoff analog terminals is generalized to robot TCP transport and 100 ms OPC-UA power-source transfers.
controls.rationale: The paper distinguishes analog distributed-clock precision from sampling intervals and communication latency.

controls.mutation: The 0.1 ms process current/voltage sampling interval is assigned to robot, power-source, video and geometry streams as if they shared one sample cadence.
controls.rationale: Streams share a master timestamp basis but have different sample intervals.

controls.mutation: Layer L1 is required to have a separate L1 scan_post file rather than mapping its after-state to L2 scan_pre.
controls.rationale: The article explicitly maps the resulting surface after layer n to the scan_pre file of layer n+1 for layers 1-5.

controls.mutation: The L2 scan_pre measurement is treated only as a before-L2 surface and is never linked as the after-L1 surface.
controls.rationale: Each scan file participates in adjacent layer-state mapping; scan roles are not independent snapshots.

controls.mutation: WID630 L6, WID631 L5/L6 or WID632 L2/L6 t8/5 values are populated from interpolation or zero despite source-reported unavailable thermocouple measurements.
controls.rationale: The paper identifies these five records as unavailable due to insufficient thermocouple attachment.

controls.mutation: The L1 single-wire PMC root passes are included in a tandem-GMAW-only training/evaluation denominator.
controls.rationale: The source article explicitly says the single-wire root pass is not to be included in analyses strictly limited to T-GMAW.

controls.mutation: WID617 is counted as an independent replicate of a randomized process-mode treatment rather than a repeat of an earlier published parameter sequence.
controls.rationale: The article positions WID617 as a repeat of a published configuration using modern T-GMAW equipment.

controls.mutation: The WID631/WID632 matched-parameter mode contrast (one specimen per mode) is promoted to a replicated causal claim across all workpieces and shipyards.
controls.rationale: It is a useful controlled exploratory pair but has one workpiece per mode and no independent replication.

published_article.title: Multimodal experimental data for tandem gas metal arc welding of thick steel plates with advanced pulsed and short-circuiting process modes

clock_contract.drift_bound_scope: Beckhoff EtherCAT analog-to-digital terminals; do not apply this precision claim to all channel sample intervals or upstream robot/OPC-UA transfer latency

surface_scan_contract.after_layer_storage_rule: For L1-L5, the after-state for layer n is the scan_pre file of layer n+1. For L6, the after-state is the L6 scan_post file.
